NMHC Newsroom
Find the latest news and analysis on the apartment industry.
Media Resources
Designed to give working journalists quick access to NMHC’s information and analysis about the apartment industry.
Newsletters
From capital markets to Capitol Hill to the state of the industry, NMHC has a series of newsletters to keep you informed.
Research Corner
NMHC's Research Corner is the clearinghouse for insights into economic and fiscal announcements and news. These pronouncements are intended to provide the perspective of housing providers and residents into significant financial declarations and reports.
Code53 Podcast
Welcome to Code 53, the podcast presented by NMHC for everyone who loves apartment buildings and wants to better understand how all the many players work together to create so many homes for so many people.
One Nation, Underhoused
NMHC's President Sharon Wilson Géno's blog series.
